Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The complete diff meets issue #3846. The fixed row requires the result, reviewed head, and evidence. It keeps `Not run` distinct from a pass. The new policy test pins these requirements. The decision record explains the choice. The body has `Process change: yes`, and the PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION`.

Local results against upstream/main `034e91b8b78fa64989d18e1d5d17344531c4762c`:

- The trial merge reports “Already up to date.” Main is the direct parent of the reviewed head. No merge commit is needed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 336 passed, 1 failed in the xtask unit step. The only failure is pre-existing; see below.
- `cargo test -p xtask heavy_plan_tests:: -- --nocapture`: PASS, 12 tests. This includes `review_report_always_has_a_light_lane_result_row`.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- `git diff upstream/main...HEAD --check`: PASS.

| Step | Result | Head | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`) | PASS | `47e1aa31ead182dc9302aa9bf8df0ac4f293f8fb` | Local: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 11 tests passed. Logs: `.claude/worktrees/review-4069/gate-logs/light-20261125-214341/`. |

Light tests: motion lib (7), `adaptive_troch_island` (1), `adaptive_troch_neck` (1), `adaptive_troch_parallel` (1), and app `pocket_pass_start` (1).

Pre-existing host failure: `watchdog_tests::a_silent_step_is_killed_as_a_tree_and_named`, at `xtask/src/watchdog_tests.rs:93`:

```text
the child and the grandchild were alive: error: gate watchdog: STALL 1min: no output; killed the process tree; alive: ? (47952)
```

The same test fails alone on bare upstream/main. The complete quick-step command also fails there: 335 passed, 1 failed. Only the process IDs differ. This host refuses access to the process list (`ps: operation not permitted`). This failure does not block this PR. No tracking issue was identified. The PR quick log is `gate-logs/quick-20261125-214119/01-xtask_unit_tests.log` in the review worktree.

Extra suites run: the 12 `heavy_plan_tests` above. No fixture, importer, UI, post, operation, motion, or catalog file changed. The additional importer and catalog suites do not apply. No goldens moved. No safety-tier mutation is required; no mutation was run.

The initial cache-backed build was stopped after it produced no artifacts. The completed checks used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=`. No GitHub runner was used. The review worktree and branch remain for the next round.

Requested before merge: none. Set `merge-ready` because the diff is clean and GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`. The only quick failure also occurs on bare main.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
left for the maintainer: check 6 skip - process files (.claude/, xtask/).
